caption: The video captures a high-dynamic-range mountain lake held in a fixed composition, with forested slopes on either side, a sunlit orange patch on the left peak, a snow-covered glacier in the central gap, and rounded rocks along the near shore. The camera remains static, with mountains, glacier, forest, and stones holding their positions. Motion is primarily visible in the sky and water. A cumulus cloud mass near the center of the blue sky slowly drifts and reshapes, its outline spreading as the excerpt progresses. A smaller cloud near the upper-right ridge likewise changes form. On the turquoise lake, the bright reflection of the central cloud tracks the moving cloud above, deforming and repositioning in step with it. Fine ripples animate the surface, and the mirror-like reflections of mountains and sky shimmer subtly. The cloud drift is already underway at the start and continues past the end, leaving the scene in quiet, ongoing change.
